# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 29 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 36 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_029_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 29

**1** Jesus said: "If the flesh came into being because of spirit, that is a marvel.

**2** But if spirit came into being because of the body, that is a marvel of marvels.

**3** But as for me, I marvel at how this great wealth has made its home in this poverty."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- Two conditional marvels: spirit before flesh / flesh before spirit — both are wonders; the direction is secondary
- "Marvel of marvels" — the superlative; if matter produced spirit, the wonder is even greater
- "Great wealth" in "this poverty" — the cohabitation of spirit and flesh is the supreme marvel
- "Made its home" — the dwelling metaphor; the spirit is at home in the body, however poor it is
